title: The Sky Opened Wide
old_p1: Ezekiel was a prophet. A prophet is someone Heavenly Father talks to, so he can teach the people. The army of Babylon had taken Ezekiel’s people far from home.
One day, by a river in that faraway land, the sky opened up. Heavenly Father showed Ezekiel a vision. A vision is a picture from Heavenly Father that a prophet sees.
old_p2: Ezekiel saw a shining throne, a king’s chair, and Someone glowing on it, with bright light all around.

Around the light was a rainbow, just like the one you see in the clouds after it rains. Everyone had seen a rainbow, so Ezekiel used it to tell people how bright and beautiful it was. He bowed down low.
Heavenly Father’s light is beautiful and kind. Tonight you can lie still and feel glad that He is so wonderful.
p1: Ezekiel told the people what Heavenly Father said. An army from Babylon had taken him and his people far from home.
One day Ezekiel was by a river there. Suddenly the sky opened wide! Heavenly Father showed him a vision, a picture from heaven.
Ezekiel saw a king’s chair with Someone shining on it. Bright light was all around Him.
p2: Around the light was a rainbow, like one in the clouds after rain. Ezekiel used a rainbow to help us see how beautiful it was. He did not hurry past. He bowed down low with wonder.
Even far from home, Heavenly Father was still near Ezekiel. The next time you see a rainbow, stop and look with wonder. Say thank you to Heavenly Father.
